decisive.note: Thread-scoped, asked ~8 s after thread/start and given ~8 s to answer. The 2026-09-10 capture recorded this request unanswered within its bounded window; on this form and with those waits it answered.

The filtering is app-server's, above the server. What this does not state: the exact tool payload of the model request, which no client-visible method returns.
